description: Defines the ProductAttribute entity class for product attribute management in an e-commerce system, including fields for price, weight, options, and display properties.

classes.name: ProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing product attributes with various properties such as price, weight, options, and display flags.

methods.name: getAttributePrice
methods.description: Returns the attribute price as a string.

methods.name: setAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the attribute price from a string value.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: getProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute is free.

methods.name: setProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is free.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight associated with the attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight associated with the attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeDefault
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute is default.

methods.name: setAttributeDefault
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is default.

methods.name: getAttributeRequired
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute is required.

methods.name: setAttributeRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is required.

methods.name: getAttributeDisplayOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute is display-only.

methods.name: setAttributeDisplayOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is display-only.

methods.name: getAttributeDiscounted
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute is discounted.

methods.name: setAttributeDiscounted
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is discounted.

methods.name: getProductOption
methods.description: Returns the associated ProductOption.

methods.name: setProductOption

methods.name: getProductOptionValue

methods.description: Sets the associated ProductOptionValue.

methods.name: setAttributeSortOrder

methods.name: getAttributeAdditionalWeight
methods.description: Returns the additional weight as a string.

methods.name: setAttributeAdditionalWeight
methods.description: Sets the additional weight.

methods.description: Returns the product attribute price.
